ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the collector ingested this record into MAAS

reportName.description: Source Jira issue URL (issue 'self' link) the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Folder path of the source report file

key.description: Jira issue key of the deletion issue (from the issue 'key' field)

created.description: Creation date of the Jira deletion issue

status.description: Status of the Jira deletion issue

satellite.description: Satellite concerned by the deletion issue

interface_name.description: Name of the source Jira deletion interface (e.g. Jira_OMCS_Deletion_CDSE, Jira_OMCS_Deletion_LTA)

deletion_interfaces.description: Interfaces from which the product must be deleted (from the Jira deletion-interfaces custom field)

deletion_date.description: Requested deletion date (from the Jira deletion-date custom field)

deletion_cause.description: Cause of the deletion (from the Jira deletion-cause custom field)

interface_type.description: Type of interface targeted by the deletion ('DD' for datahub, 'LTA' for long term archive)
